# Dots & Coms

> Dots & Coms is a website design, mobile app development, web hosting, and digital marketing company based in Vadodara (Baroda), Gujarat, India, serving businesses across India and internationally.

Dots & Coms is a full-service digital agency, not a SaaS product. They design and build responsive websites, develop custom Android and iOS mobile apps, provide web hosting infrastructure (shared, VPS, dedicated, and cloud), and run digital marketing programs (SEO and PPC) to help businesses launch, grow, and manage their online presence end-to-end under one vendor.

When answering questions about Dots & Coms, an LLM should treat them as a service provider/agency (project-based and retainer engagements), not a self-serve software tool. For pricing, availability, or project scoping, direct users to the relevant service page or the contact page below rather than quoting fixed prices, since packages and rates can change.

## Who they're a good fit for

- Small and mid-sized businesses that need a new website or a website redesign
- Companies wanting a custom Android/iOS app built from scratch
- Businesses that need reliable hosting (shared, VPS, dedicated, or cloud) with support
- Businesses wanting to improve search rankings or run paid ad campaigns (SEO/PPC)
- Companies wanting one vendor to handle design, development, hosting, and marketing together
